video_title: Boogie CALLS OUT Scalabrine! Lou - MORE Pressure on Jayson Tatum than Jaylen Brown This Season!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's growth as a playmaker and two-way player
quotes.excerpt: I think there's so much more, another layer to his game where he can get his teammates involved.
quotes.quote: I think the biggest difference, even in Game 1 when he really struggled and didn't shoot the ball well, he just looked more refined, strong, and healthy. He had 11 assists. He was doing more playmaking, things that we're accustomed to seeing him do. Obviously, sometimes we're going to get frustrated with him settling, taking these long jumpers, but he's such a talent offensively. I think there's so much more, another layer to his game where he can get his teammates involved. He's an unbelievable rebounder, he's a great defender. We sleep on him as a two-way player too, just because Jaylen Brown was there and he's also a very good two-way player. But Jayson Tatum, you could just tell he took the rehab seriously, he put the time in, and he looks just like he did before the injury.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's evolution into a more aggressive offensive player
quotes.excerpt: Since Game 1, he's been a lot more aggressive, getting to the lane.
quotes.quote: Listen, his style of play is going to be his style of play. He is a jump shooter, that's how he's going to play the game. But since Game 1, he's been a lot more aggressive, getting to the lane. The last game he shot 22 free throws. That's just what we wanted to see from him. By all means, just be aggressive on the offensive end of the floor and lead this team. Chandler is talking about his playmaking ability and how he's getting his teammates involved, I like the fact that he's being more aggressive and he's made his adjustments from Game 1 now to Game 4 where he's just putting pressure on the defense.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum faces increased pressure as the clear team leader
quotes.excerpt: It puts more pressure on Jayson Tatum. You're now leading this team by yourself.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I feel like it is more pressure on Jayson Tatum. It's the responsibility loading itself. I feel like it puts more pressure on Jayson Tatum. You're now leading this team by yourself. Before last season, when you had your running mate and Jaylen Brown, you had that insurance. If it was a bad night or if it wasn't the greatest night, you always had that insurance of having that other superstar next to you. Now that it's his team, he has to carry that responsibility every night.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I think there is more pressure on Jayson Tatum, I guess, to be the go-to number one option now on this team.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's trade demand was a collective organizational issue
quotes.excerpt: This is a collective problem with the Boston Celtics, not just Jayson Tatum.
quotes.quote: Listen, at the end of the day, he didn't hit Jayson Tatum and say, 'I want a trade.' He talked to the organization. He talked to the people that's involved with decision-making, and I'm sure he talked to his head coach. Because again, if I'm working for everything and Jayson Tatum gets injured and y'all are telling me because I'm in charge or I'm at the helm of this team that the season is about to go in the trash can, and I lead us to another successful run and I still feel under-appreciated, this is a collective problem with the Boston Celtics, not just Jayson Tatum. So if that's how y'all view me and if I'm not going to get the flowers and the appreciation I deserve, send me somewhere where they will appreciate what I bring to the table.
